integrity: The proof is analytic and reduces the Singer constant to the published identity D(X)DW_S(X)=2. The new computation minimizes the regular-polygon radial formula over all isosceles-orthogonal pairs and all scalar parameters by a complete angular case split. The bundled numerical/symbolic script is only a reproducibility check and is not used as a finite proof of the infinite family. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers regular polygonal unit balls with side count divisible by 4. It does not determine DW_S for regular polygons with side count congruent to 2 modulo 4, nor the classical, isosceles-restricted, or Birkhoff-restricted Dunkl–Williams constants.
title: Singer–Dunkl–Williams constant of every regular fourfold polygonal Banach plane
